critical_code_review_comments: CrudListTool.jsx (229 lines) — clean shared scaffold, fields-array driven, group-by-kind facet, window.confirm() correctly used (line 81). Tailwind class-bundle pattern (WRITER_THEME emerald/rose) correctly avoids dynamic class composition. data-testid prefix discipline is consistent.

writer_tools.py — Cultures/Cosmology/POV/Themes routes use extra='forbid' on Pydantic models (verified by 422 on bogus_field). Cosmology and Themes additionally enforce explicit kind whitelist with 400 on both POST and PATCH (verified). Auto-order-per-kind on cosmology works (each new kind starts at order=10).

Minor: PATCH endpoints for cultures/cosmology/pov/themes reuse the FULL CreateIn schema (required 'name', required 'kind' for cosmology/themes). Means clients MUST resend name on every PATCH. Functional but inconsistent with manuscript_patch which has a dedicated PatchIn model with all-optional fields. Consider adding *PatchIn variants for symmetry in a future drop; not a regression today (UI sends full payload).

AtelierTab.jsx wiring (lines 241-306) — each of the 4 new tools mounted under Suspense with explicit data-testid 'atelier-wb-cultures-pane' / 'atelier-wb-cosmology-pane' / 'atelier-st-pov-pane' / 'atelier-st-themes-pane'. Clean and follows the wb-atlas pattern.
